QUOTE: `ServerManager::args_to_pattern` takes the first string value of the arguments, and returns `*` when there is none.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says only the first string argument is used for matching and that it falls back to `*` when there is none. That covers the single-value point and the wildcard fallback. It does not say the other arguments are invisible, and it does not mention non-string or unparseable arguments. Both are implied by "first string value … `*` when there is none".
